|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “[Pilot] 3. Cards with “Han” in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett’s or Jabba’s game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the release-sheet wording again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “Boba Fett’s or Jabba’s game text” to “Boba Fett or Jabba's game text” (“Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots” is the card list's spelling of the pilot icon, not a change). PC-E1 text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Cards with 'Han' in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett or Jabba's game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.”<ref name="cl-1210_101">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card-list entry ends with the Players Committee's own label “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”, the date of the errata that the “E” slip also shows; the wording of the entry differs from the slip as described.
